# Viettel Cloud Provider

Viettel Cloud Provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    viettelcloud = {
      source  = "viettelcloud-oss/viettelcloud"
      version = "~> 0.1.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "viettelcloud" {
  endpoint   = var.viettelcloud_endpoint
  token      = var.viettelcloud_token
  project_id = var.viettelcloud_project_id
}

variable "viettelcloud_endpoint" {
  type = string
}

variable "viettelcloud_token" {
  sensitive = true
  type      = string
}

variable "viettelcloud_project_id" {
  type = string
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint` (String) API endpoint URL
- `project_id` (String) Project ID (UUID) or project slug. If the value is a UUID, it is used directly; otherwise it is resolved as a project slug.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Personal access token.
